description.raw: '''Passive:''' Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] that trigger a ''[[File:Jhin Captive Audience.png|20xpx|border|link=Jhin#Captive Audience|An icon for Jhin's ability Captive Audience]] [[Jhin#Captive Audience|Lotus Trap]]'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
description.text: Passive: Enemy champions that trigger a Lotus Trap to bloom or are damaged by Jhin or allied champions are marked for 4 seconds.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals physical damage to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].
description2.text: Active: Jhin fires a shot in the target direction that deals physical damage to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against minions.

description3.raw: Hitting a ''marked'' champion [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|roots]] them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' [[File:Jhin Whisper.png|20xpx|border|link=Jhin#Whisper|An icon for Jhin's ability Whisper]] [[Jhin#Whisper|Every Moment Matters']] [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed.
description3.text: Hitting a marked champion roots them for a duration and grants Jhin Every Moment Matters'  bonus movement speed.

leveling2.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 (+ 50% AD)
'''Minion Damage:'''
52.5 / 78.75 / 105 / 131.25 / 157.5 (+ 37.5% AD)

notes.raw: * Applies [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]] to the enemy champion and [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]] to all other enemy units. * The ''Caught Out'' mark only appears if ''Deadly Flourish'' can potentially [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] the target, and will not if the ability's cooldown is longer than 4 seconds or isn't ranked up. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time. * The ability will not preserve the caster's facing direction when using [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] and similar effects. * Uniquely, ''Deadly Flourish'' is special-cased to be [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|intercepted]] by valid counters because it looks like a blockable missile, even though it functionally is not a missile. * While [[File:Neeko Inherent Glamour.png|20xpx|border|link=Neeko#Inherent Glamour|An icon for Neeko's ability Inherent Glamour]] [[Neeko#Inherent Glamour|disguised]] as a non-champion, [[File:Neeko OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Neeko|An icon representing Neeko]] [[Neeko]] cannot be affected by ''Deadly Flourish''.(bug)
notes.text:
Applies spell damage to the enemy champion and area damage to all other enemy units.
The Caught Out mark only appears if Deadly Flourish can potentially root the target, and will not if the ability's cooldown is longer than 4 seconds or isn't ranked up.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
The ability will not preserve the caster's facing direction when using Flash and similar effects.
Uniquely, Deadly Flourish is special-cased to be intercepted by valid counters because it looks like a blockable missile, even though it functionally is not a missile.
While disguised as a non-champion, Neeko cannot be affected by Deadly Flourish.(bug)
